entries.description_source_en: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
entries.fact_source_en: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
entries.description_ru: Грибной покемон, обитающий во влажной почве глубоко в лесу.
entries.fact_ru: Шрумиш питается перегнившими листьями и часто прячется под лесной подстилкой.

entries.description_source_en: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
entries.fact_source_en: The seeds ringing BRELOOM’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this POKéMON’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.
entries.description_ru: Боевой грибной покемон с невероятно быстрыми ударами.
entries.fact_ru: Семена на хвосте Брелума содержат затвердевшие ядовитые споры и совершенно несъедобны.

entries.description_source_en: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
entries.fact_source_en: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
entries.description_ru: Ленивец-покемон, проводящий почти весь день в отдыхе.
entries.fact_ru: Слакот ест всего три листа в день, ведь почти не расходует энергию.

entries.description_source_en: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
entries.fact_source_en: VIGOROTH is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this POKéMON to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.
entries.description_ru: Неугомонный покемон, неспособный спокойно сидеть на месте.
entries.fact_ru: Даже во сне Вигороту приходится сначала выплеснуть накопившуюся энергию.

entries.description_source_en: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
entries.fact_source_en: Wherever SLAKING live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the POKéMON as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.
entries.description_ru: Огромный ленивец, предпочитающий лежать весь день.
entries.fact_ru: Слакинг съедает всю траву вокруг себя и лишь затем нехотя перебирается на новое место.

entries.description_source_en: Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
entries.fact_source_en: NINCADA lives underground. It uses its sharp claws to carve the roots of trees and absorb moisture and nutrients. This POKéMON can’t withstand bright sunlight so avoids it.
entries.description_ru: Подземный покемон, годами живущий в полной темноте.
entries.fact_ru: Нинкада избегает солнечного света и получает влагу и питательные вещества из корней деревьев.

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
entries.fact_source_en: If NINJASK is not trained properly, it will refuse to obey the TRAINER and cry loudly continuously. Because of this quality, this POKéMON is said to be one that puts the TRAINER’s abilities to the test.
entries.description_ru: Невероятно быстрый покемон, питающийся древесным соком.
entries.fact_ru: Если Нинджаска плохо тренировать, он перестаёт слушаться своего тренера.

entries.description_source_en: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.
entries.fact_source_en: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
entries.description_ru: Загадочный покемон с пустой оболочкой вместо тела.
entries.fact_ru: По легенде, тот, кто заглянет в пустую спину Шединьи, лишится своей души.

entries.description_source_en: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you’re close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you’ll be stuck with an all-day headache.
entries.fact_source_en: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
entries.description_ru: Небольшой покемон с удивительно громким голосом.
entries.fact_ru: Крик Визмура превышает 100 децибел и способен вызвать головную боль.

entries.description_source_en: Loudred’s ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.
entries.fact_source_en: LOUDRED shouts while stamping its feet. After it finishes shouting, this POKéMON becomes incapable of hearing anything for a while. This is considered to be a weak point.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, превращающий свои уши в мощные звуковые усилители.
entries.fact_ru: После особенно громкого крика Лаудред некоторое время ничего не слышит.

entries.description_source_en: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.
entries.fact_source_en: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, чей рёв когда-то использовали для связи между далёкими городами.
entries.fact_ru: Перед мощным криком Эксплауд делает глубокий вдох через отверстия на теле.

entries.description_source_en: It practices its slaps by repeatedly slapping tree trunks. It has been known to slap an Exeggutor and get flung away.
entries.fact_source_en: MAKUHITA has a tireless spirit - it will never give up hope. It eats a lot of food, gets plenty of sleep, and it trains very rigorously. By living that way, this POKéMON packs its body with energy.
entries.description_ru: Усердный боец, ежедневно тренирующий силу ударов.
entries.fact_ru: Макухита становится сильнее благодаря постоянным тренировкам, еде и крепкому сну.

entries.description_source_en: Although they enjoy comparing their strength, they’re also kind. They value etiquette, praising opponents they battle.
entries.fact_source_en: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this POKéMON’s powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.
entries.description_ru: Могучий мастер рукопашного боя, уважающий достойных соперников.
entries.fact_ru: Один удар раскрытой ладонью Хариямы способен переломить телефонный столб.

entries.description_source_en: The ball on Azurill’s tail bounces like a rubber ball, and it’s full of the nutrients the Pokémon needs to grow.
entries.fact_source_en: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
entries.description_ru: Маленький водный покемон с упругим шариком на хвосте.
entries.fact_ru: Азурилл использует хвост как лассо и может забрасывать себя на большое расстояние.

entries.description_source_en: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.
entries.fact_source_en: NOSEPASS had been said to be completely unmoving, with its magnetic nose pointed due north. However, close observation has revealed that the POKéMON actually moves by a little over 3/8 of an inch every year.
entries.description_ru: Каменный покемон, чей нос всегда указывает строго на север.
entries.fact_ru: Ноузпасс движется настолько медленно, что за год смещается всего на несколько миллиметров.

entries.description_source_en: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
entries.fact_source_en: SKITTY is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this POKéMON lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.
entries.description_ru: Игривый покемон, обожающий гоняться за всем движущимся.
entries.fact_ru: Скитти нередко начинает преследовать собственный хвост и сам от этого кружится.

entries.description_source_en: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
entries.fact_source_en: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
entries.description_ru: Свободолюбивый покемон, живущий исключительно по собственному расписанию.
entries.fact_ru: Делкатти ест и спит тогда, когда сам этого захочет.

entries.description_source_en: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.
entries.fact_source_en: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside caverns. They are feared, however, because these POKéMON are thought to steal the spirits of people when their eyes burn with a sinister glow in the darkness.
entries.description_ru: Пещерный покемон, питающийся драгоценными камнями.
entries.fact_ru: Сэйблай предпочитает карбинков и, по легендам, пугает людей светящимися глазами.

entries.description_source_en: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
entries.fact_source_en: MAWHILE’s huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, MAWHILE chomps it with its gaping jaws.
entries.description_ru: Хитрый покемон, скрывающий опасность за милой внешностью.
entries.fact_ru: Огромные челюсти Мавайла на самом деле являются преобразованными стальными рогами.

entries.description_source_en: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
entries.fact_source_en: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
entries.description_ru: Стальной покемон, укрепляющий броню железной рудой.
entries.fact_ru: Арон иногда объедает железнодорожные рельсы и металлические мосты.

entries.description_source_en: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.
entries.fact_source_en: LAIRON feeds on iron contained in rocks and water. It makes its nest on mountains where iron ore is buried. As a result, the POKéMON often clashes with humans mining the iron ore.
entries.description_ru: Бронированный покемон, живущий в богатых железом горах.
entries.fact_ru: Из-за любви к железной руде Лайрон нередко конфликтует с шахтёрами.

entries.description_source_en: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.
entries.fact_source_en: AGGRON is surprisingly protective of its environment. If its mountain is ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this POKéMON will haul topsoil to the area, plant trees, and beautifully restore its own territory.
entries.description_ru: Мощный стальной покемон с невероятно прочным рогом.
entries.fact_ru: Аггрон заботится о своей горе, восстанавливая лес после пожаров и оползней.

entries.description_source_en: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
entries.fact_source_en: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, посвятивший жизнь медитации и духовным тренировкам.
entries.fact_ru: Медитайт постоянно теряет концентрацию, поэтому его обучение никогда не заканчивается.

entries.description_source_en: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
entries.fact_source_en: Through the power of meditation, MEDICHAM developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This POKéMON is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
entries.description_ru: Мастер медитации, развивший мощные психические способности.
entries.fact_ru: Медичам способен месяцами медитировать почти без пищи.

entries.description_source_en: Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
entries.fact_source_en: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its long body hair. This POKéMON stimulates its leg muscles with electric charges. These jolts of power give its legs explosive acceleration performance.
entries.description_ru: Электрический покемон, создающий статическое электричество трением шерсти о воздух.
entries.fact_ru: Разряды стимулируют мышцы Электрайка и позволяют ему молниеносно ускоряться.
